# kunalai.in: A field guide to the AI decade

> AI explained for the people who run things and don't write code. By Kunal Mukherjee, Mumbai: 20+ years in Indian media (Disney, UTV Network, Times Network), runs ImagiNXT, India's tech and innovation festival, and writes the What the AI!? newsletter for non-technical managers.

## Sections
- [Perspectives](https://kunalai.in/#perspectives): five camps on how big AI is and what to do about it. Kunal's camp is Augment.
- [Your job](https://kunalai.in/#jobs): what AI absorbs, what stays human, and the next skill for marketing, finance, sales, operations, HR, customer support, software, content, legal and leadership.
- [What to study](https://kunalai.in/#study): learning paths for students, professionals and leaders.
- [People to follow](https://kunalai.in/#people): pioneers, builders, translators, sceptics and Indian voices.
- [Reads](https://kunalai.in/#reads): curated newsletters, books, essays, reports and India sources.
- [About](https://kunalai.in/#about)
